title: frangula sphaerosperma
intro: Frangula sphaerosperma, commonly known as Round-fruited Buckthorn, is a plant species in the family Rhamnaceae. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating gastrointestinal issues, such as constipation and diarrhea, due to its ability to stimulate bowel movements and soothe the digestive system. The therapeutic actions of Frangula sphaerosperma are attributed to its anthraquinone glycosides, which act as laxatives and have anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include anthraquinone glycosides, including rhein and aloe-emodin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
